name: HUBLINE
recent: Hubline Berhad 近期确认其子公司运营的一架直升机在砂拉越发生致命坠毁事故，造成五人死亡。同时，公司董事及主要股东在闭市期间进行了股权交易，包括董事经理 Ling Li Kuang 增持股份，以及 Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee 间接减持股份。最新财报显示季度营收环比增长20%，净亏损收窄。
notable: 公司确认其子公司运营的直升机在砂拉越 Long Lellang 坠毁，造成五人死亡。
董事经理 Ling Li Kuang 在公开市场增持 4,120,000 股普通股。
Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee 间接减持 33,000,000 股普通股（场外交易）。
risks: 子公司涉及的直升机坠毁事故造成五人死亡，可能引发监管审查或法律诉讼。
Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee 间接减持 33,000,000 股，占已发行股份约 0.769%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 MYR 46.164 million，环比增长20.0%，同比增长5.3%；净亏损为 MYR 299,000，净亏损率从上一季度的7.4%收窄至0.6%。

recent_en: Hubline Berhad recently confirmed that a helicopter operated by its subsidiary crashed fatally in Sarawak, killing five people. Meanwhile, directors and substantial shareholders traded shares during the closed period, including Managing Director Ling Li Kuang acquiring shares and Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee indirectly disposing of shares. The latest financial results show a 20% QoQ revenue growth and a narrower net loss.
notable_en: The company confirmed that a helicopter operated by its subsidiary crashed in Long Lellang, Sarawak, killing five people.
Managing Director Ling Li Kuang acquired 4,120,000 ordinary shares on the open market.
Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee indirectly disposed of 33,000,000 ordinary shares via off-market transaction.
risks_en: The helicopter crash involving the subsidiary killed five people and may lead to regulatory scrutiny or legal proceedings.
Group Executive President Dato Sri Richard Wee indirectly disposed of 33,000,000 shares, representing approximately 0.769% of issued shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 46.164 million, up 20.0% QoQ and 5.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 299,000, with net loss margin narrowing from 7.4% in the previous quarter to 0.6%.
